chapter_title_en: The Prison of Ten Thousand Evils
chapter_seo_title: Source of All Evil Revealed: Female Corpse Breaks Through the Ancient Prison
chapter_meta_description: The female corpse effortlessly destroys a stone man guardian and a giant clam, then shatters palace after palace, absorbing imprisoned souls. Xiao Chen realizes the 'Source of All Evil' is a prison for ancient criminals.
og_title: Female Corpse Dominates the Prison of the Source of All Evil
og_description: Witness the female corpse's instinct-driven power as she defeats a stone man king-level guardian, breaks a giant clam, and devours palace prisoners—revealing the Source of All Evil as a sealed prison.
twitter_title: Female Corpse Shatters the Source of All Evil Prison
twitter_description: The female corpse's instinct-led rampage through the stone jar's inner world exposes the Source of All Evil as a prison for ancient criminals. Xiao Chen watches in awe.
